initialExam.title: KVS TGT (Trained Graduate Teacher) 2026
initialExam.description: KVS TGT recruitment for teaching Classes 6-10 in Kendriya Vidyalayas. Subjects include English, Hindi, Math, Science, Social Studies.
initialExam.syllabus: Part-I: Hindi, English, GK, Reasoning, Computer (50Q). Part-II: Subject-specific (100Q). Demo Teaching & Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Demo Teaching → Interview → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Trained Graduate Teacher in Kendriya Vidyalayas
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit kvsangathan.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Summer/Winter vacation, Children Education Allowance
